Shared `.index.lock`, `.gates.lock`, and `.events.lock` acquisitions instead deliberately proceed without an OS lock when their path cannot be opened ([lock.rs:253](crates/jit/src/storage/lock.rs:253)); they do not create `.jit/`, but they are not typed repository-not-found failures. Scope the statement to the repository write lock or document shared-lock behavior accurately. References: @/issue/dd1b984c/requirement/REQ-01.
